end.summary:
Reyansh practised top, front and side views of cones, cylinders, cubes and cuboids.
They matched views to objects correctly in 4 of 4 attempts.
They described a cone as a circle from above and a triangle from the side.
They did not yet explain why views change from different places; the same-view mix-up remained at the end.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised using the shape of each solid’s top, front and side view to identify it. Using features such as a cone’s round base and point helped them match all four views correctly. They mixed up whether two people in different places see the same view, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, place a cup or box on a table and ask Reyansh to draw what it looks like from two different positions.
